verdict.rationale: Perplexity documents an official 'Computer MCP server' that lets an MCP client delegate multi-step web research, browsing, and code-execution tasks and receive structured results, with a dedicated docs page and probe confirming its existence (perplexity-docs-5,17,18,19,29,30; perplexity-probe-4). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that the MCP server itself works reliably — community reports (perplexity-comm-7) describe the underlying 'Computer' feature frequently failing to trigger or stalling, which raises reliability concerns even though it doesn't directly test the MCP endpoint.
